# Falmouth test fixtures

Real data, cropped (≈6 km square around Falmouth, Cornwall) for offline tests.

- `topo.tif`, `mask.tif`: GMRT GridServer (layers `topo` and `topo-mask`), retrieved 2026-10-30. GMRT is CC BY 4.0; see https://www.gmrt.org/about/terms_of_use.php. Cite: Ryan et al. (2009), doi:10.1029/2008GC002332.
- `coast.geojson`: OpenStreetMap `natural=coastline` ways, © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
